description: Register a real person's housing need. A real person must have asked for this submission and agreed to it and to sharing the necessary personal data with AstraNL. Never use this tool for test or synthetic data. Include only necessary information about the housing problem and the person to contact. Contacts are separated from free text and kept only for this case, without enrichment. Returns a durable receipt, not a promise of processing or resolution. Set real_person and consent to true only when both statements are true.
name: housing_need
